statistical_and_implementation_review: All previously viewed periods, including 2024–2026, are exploratory V2 reuse. A new freeze does not make them an untouched holdout.

Use accession-specific facts available by acceptanceDateTime or a conservative next-session delay. Period-end dates and latest restated values are not availability timestamps. SEC filing date only should be delayed, not assumed available before the close.
8-K filing can lag the actual news and important earnings/guidance content is often in exhibits. This is an observable disclosed-risk veto, not a validated irrational-versus-fundamental label.
Missing, stale, mismatched-issuer or non-comparable financial facts should remain unknown and fail closed; never count absent data as favorable fundamentals.
Freeze 80% repair, 5% stop and 10-session cap before reading V2 outcomes. Do not select thresholds or a variant based on the reused evaluation window.

Run same-universe V1 plus fixed filter-only, exit-only and combined variants with identical cash, settlement, costs, warmups and boundary handling. Report exposure, trades, cash and coverage alongside returns.

A repaired residual should be measured relative to a fixed signal-time anchor and an explicitly defined causal peer-return chain; a rolling 5-day loss dropping from the window is not necessarily recovery.

Use consistent split/distribution units for anchor, entry cost and stop. Account for opening gaps that already satisfy the target; never assume a target execution price merely because a daily high crossed it.

If triggering on a daily close and filling next open, label it close-triggered/next-open execution. A 5% trigger is not a hard 5% maximum loss. Both overnight gaps and implementation costs can exceed it.

Incremental alpha requires paired net daily return comparisons against the corrected same-universe V1 and appropriate descriptive market-exposure benchmarks, plus uncertainty; lower exposure alone can explain lower drawdown.
Block bootstrap intervals address sampling uncertainty only, not lookahead, survivorship, publication delay or classification errors.
